## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:services` · `area:identity`, into `pm:queue`. Paged predicate writes, as #14530 moved the twin

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-12T14:55Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p3:** a pass that stops at 10,000 rows is permanent, because the once-gate never re-runs it. But no real app has been measured with more than 10,000 owner-less rows of one object in one organization, so the reach is the code path and a seed of that size.
- **Direction:**
  - `claimOrgSeedOwnership` claims by paged predicate writes, the shape `claimSeedOwnership` took in #14530 and #14719, until no owner-less row is left. The fixing seat measures that this shape fits.
  - It keeps #23008's write context (`skipAutomations`), which has landed.
  - Pin: 10,500 owner-less rows are all owned after one pass.
- Triage: lands in `packages/plugins/organizations` (`domain:services`, as #23008); rationale: one function.

Claim: PM loop round 2 · 2026-10-12T15:20Z
Session: `session_01FzQy26KznSa5j2gnf3AzsE`
Account: `zhuangjianguo` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-23054-org-seed-claim-paged`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-23054`
Domain: `domain:services`
Seat: `domain:services#2` (seat post #21118)
File surface: `packages/plugins/organizations/src/claim-org-seed-ownership.ts` and its tests under `packages/plugins/organizations/`; `packages/plugins/organizations/src/org-scoping-engine.ts` only if the paged write needs a door the package-private `OrgScopingEngine` does not name yet; one `.changeset/23054-*.md` (stop on breach; explain in the report)
Container & model: `M (one function; the paged-write shape is measured against the twin before it is adopted)`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default — dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack: "no path-derived mandate … The tier stays the PM's per-card judgment call"`
Clause-②: no — a runtime fix inside one function: no published accept set and no public signature changes (`OrgScopingEngine` is package-private).
Responsibility: `claimOrgSeedOwnership` in `packages/plugins/organizations` (the platform's own code) reads at most 10,000 owner-less ids per object | none: the ADR-0093 D7 once-gate never re-runs it, and the twin `claimSeedOwnership` (`plugin-security`) pages but is not on this path | any first-admin organization bootstrap, or objectstack-ai/cloud's install and backfill call (cloud#2794), over more than 10,000 owner-less rows of one object in one organization; no real app measured today
Thread-read: 6126773291
Serial constraints cleared: same file: #23008 landed today as `e49aaec73` (PR #23053, `CLAIM_WRITE_CTX`), and this card builds on that shape. None of the 23 open `pm:dispatched` cards' latest claims declares `packages/plugins/organizations`, and no open PR touches it (15 open PRs' file lists, read at this claim). PR #22962 touches only `plugin-security/src/claim-seed-ownership-warm-boot.test.ts`, the twin's test, disjoint. Epic #15204 / #15194 territory does not name this package.

## Seat ACCEPT: PR #23071 at `ddefed998` · landing waits on a green head

`domain:services` seat 2 · `session_01FzQy26KznSa5j2gnf3AzsE` · 2026-10-12T16:28Z, under claim `6127217957`. The dev's report is the `os-dev-report` above (`6128295137`). Checked on GitHub and on `origin/main`, not from the report.

**Checklist**
- **PR form:** draft, base `main`, assignee `zhuangjianguo`. The first line is `Fixes #23054`, then `Clause-②: no`. The only closing keyword in the body sits on #23054; #23008, #15194, #14530 and #14719 are mentioned with no keyword near them.
- **Scope:** 5 files, +601 / -106. Four are inside the claimed surface: `claim-org-seed-ownership.ts`, its two test files and `.changeset/23054-org-seed-claim-paged.md`. The fifth, `packages/plugins/organizations/vitest.config.ts`, is a declared deviation, accepted: one alias (`@objectstack/spec/data` to its source) that `check:test-source-alias` requires once the claim imports two values from that subpath. `org-scoping-engine.ts` is untouched, because the two doors it already names carry the write. No `content/docs/releases/` change. Not governed, under the 3000-line threshold (`check-governed-merges --pr 23071`).
- **Changeset:** `@objectstack/organizations` publishes (no `private`), and it already depends on `@objectstack/spec`. The patch changeset was read sentence by sentence against the diff. Its claims match the code: one predicate write per object; a 5,000-row page when the engine refuses the write over its per-row hook ceiling; `count` is the sum of affected rows; the same organization scope and `CLAIM_WRITE_CTX`; and the unit of failure moved from the row to the write.
- **Clause ②:** `no` stands. The diff touches nothing under `packages/spec/src/**`; it only imports existing exports (`MAX_BULK_PER_ROW_HOOK_ROWS`, `BULK_PER_ROW_HOOK_LIMIT_ERROR_CODE`). No accept set or public signature moves.
- **The write's scope:** every page write keeps the whole `{ organization_id, owner_id: null }` predicate and ANDs `id IN (page)` onto it. A row owned by someone, or another organization's row, is never written, and the real-engine pin asserts both (`owned` keeps its owner, `foreign` stays owner-less).
- **Tests:** the real-engine pin (`claim-org-seed-ownership-dispatch.pin.test.ts`) builds 10,500 owner-less rows, asserts the fixture is past `MAX_BULK_PER_ROW_HOOK_ROWS`, and then asserts the following: `[{ object, count: 10500 }]`, zero rows left owner-less, code-registered `beforeUpdate`/`afterUpdate` once per claimed row under `skipAutomations` and `skipTriggers`, and no metadata-bound write hook. The ablation is in the PR body: the old single-pass block was put back, the pin went red (`count: 10000`, against 10500 expected), and the restore was proven by blob hash. It ran twice, on `1faee8fa7` and on `ddefed998`.
- **CI at `ddefed9983`** (the PR's current head): 32 success, 6 skipped, 1 in progress (`Test Core (1/6)`). `Lint & Repo Gates` and `TypeScript Type Check` are `completed: success`, and so are the four `Type Check ·` lanes. The flip waits for every check.
- **Writes:** `mcp_calls` 0. Two relay writes (`pr_create` with assignee, the report comment) and the git pushes. No label written.

**Out-of-scope findings**
- The twin `claimSeedOwnership` (`plugin-security`) writes a page by id alone, so a row given a human owner between its read and its write could be re-owned: `Acceptance notes`. This is a read-only inference with no reproduction, so it is below the filing gate, and it is recorded in PR #23071's Acceptance notes.
- `.changeset/23008-org-seed-claim-skip-automations.md` says "The read is unchanged. The claim's per-object read is still a plain system read.": `dropped`. That bullet is #23008's per-change delta. The read context it describes (no `skipAutomations` on the read) still holds for the page read. This PR's own changeset, for the same package in the same release, states that below the ceiling the claim no longer reads.

**Landing:** when every check on the current head is green, `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` through the relay, and this seat follows it to MERGED.
